name: com.uee03.pretzel.input
description: Input System tools for 2D, 2.5D and 3D games: a context stack that enables one action map at a time, reasoned input blocking (for example during scene loads), input buffering, last-used-device tracking, a safe interactive rebind and persisted binding overrides. Optional adapters for Pretzel Preferences and Pretzel Scenes compile only when those modules are installed.

samples.description: A character moved through a Gameplay context, a pause that switches contexts, a buffered jump, device tracking and a rebind button with saved overrides.
